info.title: bbx — Bitbucket Cloud CLI
info.description: gh for Bitbucket Cloud. A .NET global tool for the Bitbucket Cloud API v2: repositories, pull requests, branches, tags, commits, source files, downloads, pipelines, snippets, workspaces and projects. JSON on stdout and meaningful exit codes, so scripts and LLM agents can consume it.

options.name: --branch
options.description: Branch to run the pipeline on. Defaults to the repository's main branch. Cannot be combined with --pull-request, which brings its own branches.

options.name: --commit
options.description: Specific commit hash to run on (branch trigger only)

options.name: --pull-request
options.description: Trigger the pull-request pipeline for this PR id. Both branches and both commits come from the pull request, so this sets BITBUCKET_PR_ID in the run.

options.name: --yaml
options.description: Run an on-demand pipeline: path to a YAML file, or '-' for stdin. That YAML applies to this run only, overriding bitbucket-pipelines.yml. In this mode --variable values travel in the request URL (the YAML is the body), so anything that logs URLs sees them.

options.name: --merge-defaults
options.description: On-demand only: merge repository-level defaults (image, options, clone, export, labels, definitions) into the supplied YAML. Needs a bitbucket-pipelines.yml in the repository: without one the trigger is accepted and the run then fails with 'No matching pipeline definition'.

options.name: --target-branch-to-create
options.description: On-demand only: create this branch from the requested branch or commit before the run starts, and run on it.
